Where Claude gets used for technical work — and where it does for its country

The map and the scatter show the same 279 regions. Levels asks where the computer-and-mathematical share of usage is high. Deviation from country average asks where it is high for that country — the only comparison this analysis supports. Click any region to find it in both panels.

Click any region to highlight it in both panels

Source: Anthropic Economic Index, Release 6 (April–May 2026); OECD Regional Database; BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages. Boundaries: Eurostat GISCO NUTS 2021 and Natural Earth 10m admin-1.
279 OECD TL2 regions across 35 countries; 277 are drawn on the map, as CO11 (Colombia) and ME09 (Mexico) have no matching boundary in either source. In deviation mode, three regions that are the only one in their country are shown in grey, because a country with one region defines its own average.
